crossRefs.note: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God…

crossRefs.note: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.
crossRefs.keyword: poured out like water. Heb. were poured forth with water

crossRefs.note: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yes, great lightning bolts, and routed them.
Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
He sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and confused them.
The sun and moon stood still in the sky, at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering…

translations.web: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
translations.bsb: The clouds poured down water; the skies resounded with thunder; Your arrows flashed back and forth.
translations.kjv: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
translations.asv: The clouds poured out water; The skies sent out a sound: Thine arrows also went abroad.
